title: CDA Cancels Petrol Pump Sites Auction in Islamabad
excerpt: The Capital Development Authority has called off the planned auction of seven petrol pump sites following a poor response.
body_html:
The Capital Development Authority (CDA) has called off its scheduled auction for seven petrol pump sites located in Islamabad.

This decision follows a weak response during a previous sale of hotel plots, prompting authorities to cancel the upcoming auction event.
